name: atrium-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for atrium (Phase 6, Task 6.2) — critical-path coverage for the portfolio's scroll-driven lobby: the twelve outward affordances (six live demo links + six U2 disabled repo controls), the reduced-motion static-directory path (no pin, nothing frozen), the theme toggle in both themes, full keyboard reachability of all twelve affordances, the no-JS directory render, and the SEO surface. Runs against a built + served Next app on :3080 (NOT next dev, per the project's strict-CSP/GSAP discipline). Point at any deployed URL via BASE_URL.
